description: REPLACE ME: one line on what this app is and what it is built with. Jev sees this as context for every question, so name the libraries your conventions below refer to.

hardcoded_copy.ask: Does this file contain user-visible UI text inline instead of going through i18next translation keys?
hardcoded_copy.ok: all user-visible copy is translated, or the file has no UI text. Mock data, fixtures, chart demo series, and developer-only strings do not count.

raw_fetch.ask: Does this file call fetch or axios directly instead of going through the shared request wrapper in src/services?
raw_fetch.ok: uses the shared layer, or makes no HTTP call

server_state_in_store.ask: Does this file keep server-fetched data in zustand or useState where TanStack Query would be the fit?
server_state_in_store.drift: server state held outside TanStack Query
server_state_in_store.ok: uses Query, or holds only UI state

auth_or_crypto.ask: Does this change touch authentication, authorization, permissions, encryption, decryption, or personal contact data (phone/email)?
auth_or_crypto.risk: security- or PII-sensitive code is modified
auth_or_crypto.ok: no security or PII surface is touched

data_loss.ask: Could this change lose or silently discard user-entered data, for example a save path that drops edits or a state reset that wipes in-progress input?
data_loss.risk: a realistic path exists where user input is lost
data_loss.ok: user data is preserved on every path

silent_catch.ask: Does this change swallow an error without surfacing it to the user or logging it?
silent_catch.risk: an error is caught and discarded silently
silent_catch.ok: errors surface or are logged, OR the catch is accompanied by a comment explaining why the failure is safe to ignore
